caveats: Shanita Terrell's federal civil-rights suit (Terrell v. Harris County) against Harris County, Sheriff Ed Gonzalez, and deputies Cannon/Hines over a Feb. 23, 2020 assault was dismissed with prejudice (qualified immunity / insufficient Monell allegations); the Fifth Circuit affirmed July 9, 2024 — hence 'dismissed' for the claim against the agency. Year filed: the Fifth Circuit opinion says roughly 18 months after the incident (~2021), though a Feb. 2022 news article context could suggest early 2022. A separate state-court suit against The Address bar settled confidentially (amount unknown; not paid by the agency), and the state claim against Hines was still pending as of Aug. 2023. Hines pleaded guilty in 2023 to attempted sexual assault but received 6 years deferred adjudication (technically not a conviction).
